title: A livelier loading screen for large campaigns
summary: While a large shared campaign downloads, the Lootsplitter kobold now runs off with its coin while the adventurer gives chase, above "Loading your campaign…" and how much has loaded.
items: The adventurer and the kobold run in place in the middle of the screen, on a loop.
Progress reads as a percentage, for example 42%/100%, taken from what has actually downloaded; it shows 100% only when the campaign is complete.
The size in MB and the number of parts are still shown underneath, in smaller text.
Keep waiting, Go back and Continue loading work as before, and the small progress pill now shows the percentage too.
If your device asks for reduced motion, you see the still artwork instead.
